namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Http\Requests\Tags\ListTagRequest;
use App\Http\Resources\Tags\TagResource;
use App\Models\Tag;
use Illuminate\Routing\Controller;
use Spatie\LaravelData\DataCollection;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class TagController extends Controller
{
	/**
	 * Returns the list of all tags with their photo counts.
	 *
	 * @return DataCollection<TagResource>
	 */
	public function list(ListTagRequest $request): DataCollection
	{
		$tags = Tag::query()
			->select(['tags.id', 'tags.name', DB::raw('COUNT(photo_tag.photo_id) as num')])
			->leftJoin('photo_tag', 'tags.id', '=', 'photo_tag.tag_id')
			->groupBy(['tags.id', 'tags.name'])
			->orderBy('tags.name')
			->get()
			->map(fn (Tag $tag) => new TagResource(
				name: $tag->name,
				num: (int) $tag->num
			));

		return TagResource::collect($tags);
	}
}
